model_output.verdict: A mechanical engineer with a clear product design path, but too little on what the work changed.
write_up: You’ve grown from Mechanical Engineer I to II at Westhaven, designing furniture components and now leading design for the Arlo desk platform. It’s common for engineering resumes to list the work without saying what came of it. Here, that makes it harder to stand out in a pile: a recruiter can see your tools and tasks, but not yet what your design decisions changed.

The BIFMA testing line is a good model because it names both the work and the standard you tested against. Your progression and current role are easy to follow, and your education is in the right place below your experience.

Let’s start with the Arlo line. Add a design decision or result you can speak to, then show your part in the supplier work and engineering changes. You don’t need a number on every line, but the current role needs more to show what your work accomplished.

cards.line: - Lead mechanical design for the Arlo height-adjustable desk platform
cards.cannot_tell: Leading the Arlo design is substantial work, but a recruiter can’t tell which design decisions were yours or what changed. This is the place to show what leading the platform involved.
cards.example: Lead mechanical design for the Arlo height-adjustable desk platform, including [design work] that [what changed]
cards.question: What design work did you lead on Arlo, and what changed because of it?

cards.line: - Work with suppliers in Mexico and Taiwan on tooling and first-article inspection
cards.cannot_tell: The suppliers and stages of production are clear, but your part in the work isn’t. Say what you contributed to tooling or inspection.
cards.example: Work with suppliers in Mexico and Taiwan on tooling and first-article inspection, including [your contribution]
cards.question: What did you do with the suppliers on tooling and first-article inspection?

cards.line: - Run tolerance stack-ups and FEA on load-bearing components
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see the analyses you run, but not what they found or how the findings were used. One example would show how the analysis informed the design.
cards.example: Run tolerance stack-ups and FEA on load-bearing components, identifying [findings] used to [design decision]
cards.question: What did an analysis find, and how was that finding used?

cards.line: - Support manufacturing with engineering change orders
cards.cannot_tell: Supporting manufacturing could cover several jobs. A recruiter can’t tell what you contributed to the change orders or what they addressed.
cards.example: Support manufacturing with engineering change orders by [your contribution] for [type of change]
cards.question: What did you contribute to the change orders, and what kinds of changes did they address?

cards.line: - Ran prototype testing to BIFMA standards
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model for naming the technical work and the standard it had to meet. A recruiter can tell what kind of testing you ran without guessing.

fit.note: Your experience points toward mechanical product design, especially furniture and sheet-metal components. The move from Mechanical Engineer I to II shows progression, while the current role needs more detail on what your design work accomplished.
